descriptionByLocale.de:
Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung.

Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten.

Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir einen Anlagen- und Apparatebauer Rohrbau EFZ.

Was wir dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Fachgerechtes und wirtschaftliches Ausmessen, Herstellen und Montieren von anspruchsvollen Rohrleitungen und Stützsystemen im Rohrleitungsbau

• Erstellen von Isometrien und Rohrleitungssegmenten entsprechend den technischen Vorgaben und Projektanforderungen

• Planen und Organisieren der Arbeitsabläufe anhand von R&I‑Fliessbildern,  bei Projektarbeiten und Anlagenanpassungen

• Anwenden von PED‑Richtlinien sowie Arbeiten nach internen Rohrklassen, Werknormen und qualitätssichernden Vorgaben

Dein Profil:

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Anlagen- und Apparatebauer EFZ in Rohrleitungsbau, Rohrschlosser, Heizungsmonteur oder Sanitär-Installateur

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Rohrschlosser oder Vorrichter von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung

• Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team

• Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation

• Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt.

Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.de:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.

• Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Independent operation and execution of downstream related activities according to specified instructions (manufacturing protocols / operating instructions / work instructions / SOP)

• Safe and correct execution of work in compliance with safety regulations, taking into account the cGMP quality requirements

• Responsibility for cleanliness and order at the workplace as well as the assigned rooms and storage areas

• Performing monitoring, maintenance, and cleaning tasks, as well as reporting and rectifying defects and malfunctions in the facility, including their documentation

• Every employee is involved as an equal team member through their active participation in continuous improvement processes

What we are looking for:

• Completed professional training (Apprenticeship)

• Chemical or pharmaceutical-technical training as well as GMP and/or BICO training advantageous

• Good skills in speaking, writing, and comprehension in German or English required.

• Accurate work and documentation practices

• Execution of tasks with a high level of safety and quality awareness

• Willingness to work shifts (4-shift operation) with flexibility in work scheduling

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

German Version:
Der Standort dieser Position ist in Visp, Schweiz. Bei Bedarf steht für berechtigte Kandidaten und ihre Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Was wir Ihnen bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein inklusiver und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

Zusätzlich zu einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt können Sie zahlreiche Vorteile für Lebensstil, Familie und Freizeit erwarten. Die vollständige Liste unserer lokal zugeschnittenen Benefits finden Sie unten.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Selbstständige Durchführung und Ausführung von nachgelagerten Tätigkeiten gemäß vorgegebenen Anweisungen (Herstellungsprotokolle / Bedienungsanweisungen / Arbeitsanweisungen / SOPs)

• Sicheres und korrektes Ausführen der Arbeiten unter Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften und unter Berücksichtigung der cGMP-Qualitätsanforderungen

• Verantwortung für Sauberkeit und Ordnung am Arbeitsplatz sowie in den zugewiesenen Räumen und Lagerbereichen

• Durchführung von Überwachungs-, Wartungs- und Reinigungsarbeiten sowie Meldung und Behebung von Mängeln und Störungen an den Anlagen inklusive deren Dokumentation

• Aktive Mitwirkung aller Mitarbeitenden als gleichwertige Teammitglieder an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen

Ihr Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung (Lehre)

• Chemische oder pharmazeutisch-technische Ausbildung sowie GMP- und/oder BICO-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

• Gute Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift in Deutsch oder Englisch erforderlich

• Sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und gewissenhafte Dokumentation

• Hohes Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein bei der Ausführung der Aufgaben

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (4-Schicht-Betrieb) mit Flexibilität in der Arbeitszeitgestaltung

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeitenden unsere grösste Stärke. Mit über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams jeden Tag zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Kernwerte – Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität – spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Jede Idee, ob gross oder klein, hat das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern – und genau an dieser Arbeit möchten wir Sie beteiligen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Hintergründen ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in umsetzbare Therapien zu verwandeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord zu begrüssen.

Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Bewerben Sie sich jetzt.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: Visp What you will get:
• A key role shaping our Global Engineering Functions
• Collaboration with a dynamic team in an innovative environment.
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits The Senior Manager - Process Automation Lead drives process automation strategy, governance, and recipe development activities at project level within Global Engineering, ensuring automation solutions are aligned with manufacturing and process requirements. The role serves as the primary interface between MSAT, Manufacturing, Engineering, CQV, and Automation departments, translating process intent into structured automation deliverables that enable safe, compliant, scalable, and reproducible operations. As a member of the Global Engineering Delivery organization, the Process Automation Lead leads a team of specialists and external resources responsible for process automation definition, recipe design, and digital innovation initiatives supporting both capital projects and legacy assets. The role ensures standardization of automation methodologies, lifecycle management of process automation deliverables, and implementation of digital solutions that improve efficiency, consistency, and operational excellence. What you will do:
• Lead the process automation function at project level, focusing on process automation strategy, recipe development, and integration of process requirements into automation solutions.
• Define, govern, and drive process automation scope for capital growth projects and selected legacy asset improvement initiatives.
• Serve as the primary interface between Manufacturing, MSAT, Engineering, CQV, and Automation teams to ensure alignment of process requirements and automation implementation.
• Lead the development and standardization of process automation deliverables, including functional diagrams, functional specifications, parameter tables, operating concepts, and process control strategies.
• Own and continuously improve process automation standards, methodologies, templates, and best practices across Global Engineering projects.
• Drive digitalization initiatives within process automation, including AI-enabled recipe parametrization tools, automation troubleshooting solutions, structured specification generation, and other digital innovation programs.
• Lead, mentor, and coordinate a project team of consultants, and external contractors supporting process automation activities.
• Support FATs, SATs, commissioning, qualification, startup, and troubleshooting activities, ensuring alignment between process requirements and automation execution. What we are looking for:
• BSc or MSc in Sciences or related field
• Demonstrate strong technical leadership in process automation and recipe-based manufacturing systems
• Strong expertise in process control concepts, batch automation, and recipe management methodologies
• Ability to translate complex process requirements into structured automation specifications and technical documentation
• Strong knowledge of DeltaV and modern DCS platforms from a requirements and process perspective
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured and data-driven approach
• Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority
• Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills across Engineering, Manufacturing, MSAT, and Automation organizations At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lonza’s Legal Department in Basel (Switzerland) is looking for a legal trainee to support simple contracts review, mainly Confidentiality Agreements, for a duration of 12 months (fixed term) at 50%. It is usually possible to work distributed over all days of the week. What you will get:
• A dynamic, agile career path with room to grow
• An inclusive, ethical, and supportive workplace culture
• A comprehensive benefits package tailored to your role and location What you will do:
• Main tasks are the responsibility for the internal database, including archiving of contracts and collaboration with Lonza`s external service provider and the creation, review and negotiation of simple and standardized contracts, mainly Confidentiality Agreements, for the various business units under supervision of the responsible in-house counsel.
• The trainee will also be responsible to obtain signatures on all finally negotiated contracts, correspond with the opposing party to obtain a fully executed version and file it with the Contract Insight data base.
• Depending on requirements, aptness and availability the trainee may be requested contribute to other legal or administrative tasks required by Lonza’s Legal Department. What we are looking for:
• Minimum: Bachelors in Law.
• Fluent in English and good understanding of German languages.
• The candidate shall have a diligent working method. In addition, the trainee is expected to have a quick perception and interest in legal issues. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. Join our dedicated team at Lonza in Visp and become part of a group of hardworking professionals at the forefront of life sciences. As a DSP Process Expert (m/f/d), you will play a key role in delivering cutting-edge solutions in Visp, Switzerland. This role offers the chance to work in a world-class environment where your contributions will have a lasting impact on the future of medicine. What you’ll get:
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• Along with competitive salaries, you’ll find a wide range of lifestyle, family and leisure benefits available. What you will do:
• Leading cross functional teams as a process expert tasked with technology transfers (process design and up-scaling) and timely process implementation at manufacturing scale. This includes the whole lifecycle of assigned projects from planning over coordination, implementation, control and project completion aligned with project management goals.
• Act as the interface between the process donor (customer, process development) and operations. Responsible to ensure process scalability and manufacturability.
• Securing success during technology transfer by applying formal processes and tools to manage the transfer of information, process related risks and change control
• Responsible for the resolution of process issues that may arise during manufacturing, considering all regulatory requirements
• Responsible for execution of GMP risk analysis for the manufacturing processes.
• Responsible for implementing the manufacturing process in the plant.
• Interacting directly with customers during tech transfer, campaign preparation, execution and closure including daily reporting of batch status and performance.
• Ensuring timely compilation of process related deviations, change requests and campaign reports
• Compiling CMC sections in filing documents and technical content of validation reports
• Contributing to the development and implementation of standardized MSAT procedures and processes.
• Responsible for continuous improvement of process performance
• Supervising tasks in the area of local and global MSAT initiatives or leading major task forces or troubleshooting teams.
• Evaluating and driving innovative trends within the respective area of expertise
• Acting as a mentor for scientific and production staff in different fields of expertise.
• Performing process specific trainings for production staff. What we are looking for:
• Master's degree, PhD or equivalent experience is a plus
• Preferred area of study: Biotechnology, chemical engineering or related subject areas
• More than 5 years of experience in the area of biopharma manufacturing and / or process development preferable in the area of Microbial Manufacturing
• GMP and deep understanding of bioprocess technology
• Fluency in English and German
• Strong leadership skills
• Very good communication skills and interaction with all kinds of interfaces within customers and the project organisation
• Strong team orientation
• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude
• Open-minded for new ideas and suggestions
• Agile, highly motivated and dynamic drive

descriptionByLocale.it:
Die MINTworld ist eine gemeinsame Initiative der Lonza AG in Visp und des Kanton Wallis. Auf einer Fläche von rund 1000 m² bietet sie Kindern und Jugendlichen sowohl während der Schulzeit als auch in ihrer Freizeit die Möglichkeit, die vielfältigen Fachbereiche der MINT-Disziplinen (Mathematik, Informatik, Naturwissenschaften und Technik) praxisnah zu entdecken. Kompatibel mit dem Lehrplan 21, können so Theorie und Praxis auf eine spielerische und spannende Art verknüpft werden. Mehr Infos findest du unter www.mintworld.ch. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Entwicklung und Konzeption neuer Workshops in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team
• Unterstützung bei der Ausarbeitung und Erweiterung des Angebots
• Unterstützung der Kursleiter*innen bei der Organisation und Durchführung verschiedener MINT-Workshops
• Selbstständige Leitung von Workshops
• Je nach Qualifikation Möglichkeit zur Durchführung unterstützender Forschungstätigkeiten in einem modernen Industrielabor (z. B. HPLC, GC, Titration, Zellkultivierung, Fermentation, Versuchsanlagen, Laborautomation) Was wir suchen:
• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Matura in einem MINT-relevanten Bereich oder laufendes Studium an einer Fachhochschule oder Universität im MINT-Bereich
• Alternativ auch Interessenten mit pädagogischer oder lehramtlicher Ausbildung, im Studium oder in Planung eines solchen Studiums
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
• Idealerweise erste praktische Erfahrungen in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Labortätigkeiten, CNC, 3D-Druck, Elektronik oder Informatik
• Interesse an aktiver Weiterentwicklung sowie die Suche nach einem Unternehmen, das Raum für das Einbringen und Umsetzen kreativer Ideen bietet
• Teamfähigkeit sowie selbstständiges und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten.
• Motivation zur Zusammenarbeit mit jungen Menschen in einem pädagogischen und multikulturellen Umfeld Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? • An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do:
• Lead and manage pharmaceutical projects of drug entities within commercial QC from various customers which are in late clinical development or commercial. This includes authoring and reviewing complex GMP documents and advanced project documents (e.g. specifications, protocols, reports, APQR)
• Ensure the successful and timely delivery of QC work packages for assigned projects. This includes on-time close out/authorization and provision of documents and reports (e.g. transfer, validation, batch release, stability), LIMS specifications, lead of change requests, CAPAs, investigation of deviation and OOX events. Independently and proactively address risks and resolve issues of deliverables on time for mitigation, including good communication to all stakeholders
• Responsible for end-to-end completion of sample lifecycle for assigned projects from sampling to disposal including material reconciliation in collaboration with Lab Support Team and Sample Management Team. This includes processing of associated documents and proactive management of risks/issues.
• Acts as a single point of contact for assigned projects within commercial QC.
• Represents commercial QC in Lonza internal project meetings and customer meetings for complex topics as SME (Subject Matter Expert).
• Effectively networks and liaise with partner units and relevant stakeholders within the Lonza network to ensure the successful delivery of projects.
• Reviews and approves assay documentation under cGMP following applicable SOPs and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) in a right first time and timely manner.

• Proven project management success

title: Senior Director, Programme Management & Governance Lead

titleByLocale.it: Senior Direttore, Programme Management & Governance Lead
titleByLocale.en: Senior Director, Programme Management & Governance Lead
titleByLocale.de: Senior Direktor, Programme Management & Governance Lead
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Directeur, Programme Management & Governance Lead

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. At Lonza, we are looking for a Senior Director, Programme Management & Governance Lead to lead the governance, orchestration, and delivery assurance of the Global Lonza Capability Centre (LCC) transformation programme. This highly visible leadership role will be instrumental in shaping the future of Lonza’s global service delivery model, ensuring the successful execution of a complex, multi-function transformation spanning multiple geographies and delivery waves. Partnering closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and transformation teams, you will drive alignment, governance excellence, and value realization while enabling sustainable operational scalability and long-term business growth. Key responsibilities:
• Lead the end-to-end orchestration of the Global Lonza Capability Centre transformation programme, ensuring alignment across all workstreams, delivery waves, and strategic objectives
• Act as the central integration point across design, technology, workforce, transition, and operational readiness activities to ensure successful programme execution
• Provide strategic direction and subject matter expertise in Global Business Services and Capability Centre design, challenging assumptions and guiding decision-making based on industry-leading practices
• Develop and maintain the integrated master programme roadmap, actively managing interdependencies, risks, timelines, and deliverables across all programme teams
• Design and implement the programme governance framework, including steering committees, executive forums, toll-gate reviews, decision rights, and escalation processes
• Ensure programme quality, readiness, and governance standards are consistently applied across all phases of the transformation lifecycle
• Oversee integrated wave planning and validate readiness across infrastructure, technology, workforce, transition, and service delivery activities prior to go-live
• Partner closely with transformation leaders, implementation teams, and business stakeholders to proactively identify and resolve programme risks, bottlenecks, and execution challenges
• Drive programme performance management through robust RAID processes, dependency tracking, financial oversight, and executive reporting mechanisms
• Monitor budget consumption, scope management, and value realization, ensuring execution remains aligned with the approved business case and strategic objectives
• Act as the primary interface between the programme, executive leadership, and the Transformation Office, providing clear, fact-based communication and decision support
• Lead external consulting partners, service providers, and programme vendors to ensure high-quality deliverables and successful programme outcomes
• Promote continuous improvement by embedding lessons learned, strengthening governance practices, and enhancing programme execution capabilities across subsequent transformation waves Requires qualifications:
• Extensive and proven experience leading Global Business Services (GBS), Shared Services, Global Capability Centres (GCC), or large-scale enterprise transformation programmes in complex multinational organizations, preferably Swiss headquartered
• Proven track record establishing and scaling Global Capability Centres, preferably in India, and delivering large-scale operating model transformations
• Deep expertise in programme governance, PMO leadership, executive steering, and the successful delivery of complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes
• Strong understanding of GBS and GCC operating models, including service management, transition management, governance, value realization, and business case delivery
• Experience leading technology-enabled transformations involving organizational design, workforce transitions, service migrations, and enterprise platforms such as SAP S/4HANA
• Strong knowledge of India’s capability centre ecosystem, including talent dynamics, regulatory considerations, and operational setup requirements
• Experience operating within highly regulated industries, preferably life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or CDMO environments
• Broad business understanding across functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Marketing, and Master Data Management
• Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior executives, global teams, and external partners around a common transformation agenda
• Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required; PMP (or equivalent certification) preferred.
• Fluency in English is required, German desirable
• Willingness to travel globally (30%+) is expected Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. At Lonza, we are looking for a Senior Director, Programme Management & Governance Lead to lead the governance, orchestration, and delivery assurance of the Global Lonza Capability Centre (LCC) transformation programme. This highly visible leadership role will be instrumental in shaping the future of Lonza’s global service delivery model, ensuring the successful execution of a complex, multi-function transformation spanning multiple geographies and delivery waves. Partnering closely with executive leadership, business stakeholders, and transformation teams, you will drive alignment, governance excellence, and value realization while enabling sustainable operational scalability and long-term business growth. Key responsibilities:
• Lead the end-to-end orchestration of the Global Lonza Capability Centre transformation programme, ensuring alignment across all workstreams, delivery waves, and strategic objectives
• Act as the central integration point across design, technology, workforce, transition, and operational readiness activities to ensure successful programme execution
• Provide strategic direction and subject matter expertise in Global Business Services and Capability Centre design, challenging assumptions and guiding decision-making based on industry-leading practices
• Develop and maintain the integrated master programme roadmap, actively managing interdependencies, risks, timelines, and deliverables across all programme teams
• Design and implement the programme governance framework, including steering committees, executive forums, toll-gate reviews, decision rights, and escalation processes
• Ensure programme quality, readiness, and governance standards are consistently applied across all phases of the transformation lifecycle
• Oversee integrated wave planning and validate readiness across infrastructure, technology, workforce, transition, and service delivery activities prior to go-live
• Partner closely with transformation leaders, implementation teams, and business stakeholders to proactively identify and resolve programme risks, bottlenecks, and execution challenges
• Drive programme performance management through robust RAID processes, dependency tracking, financial oversight, and executive reporting mechanisms
• Monitor budget consumption, scope management, and value realization, ensuring execution remains aligned with the approved business case and strategic objectives
• Act as the primary interface between the programme, executive leadership, and the Transformation Office, providing clear, fact-based communication and decision support
• Lead external consulting partners, service providers, and programme vendors to ensure high-quality deliverables and successful programme outcomes
• Promote continuous improvement by embedding lessons learned, strengthening governance practices, and enhancing programme execution capabilities across subsequent transformation waves Requires qualifications:
• Extensive and proven experience leading Global Business Services (GBS), Shared Services, Global Capability Centres (GCC), or large-scale enterprise transformation programmes in complex multinational organizations, preferably Swiss headquartered
• Proven track record establishing and scaling Global Capability Centres, preferably in India, and delivering large-scale operating model transformations
• Deep expertise in programme governance, PMO leadership, executive steering, and the successful delivery of complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes
• Strong understanding of GBS and GCC operating models, including service management, transition management, governance, value realization, and business case delivery
• Experience leading technology-enabled transformations involving organizational design, workforce transitions, service migrations, and enterprise platforms such as SAP S/4HANA
• Strong knowledge of India’s capability centre ecosystem, including talent dynamics, regulatory considerations, and operational setup requirements
• Experience operating within highly regulated industries, preferably life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or CDMO environments
• Broad business understanding across functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, Supply Chain, Quality, Marketing, and Master Data Management
• Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to align senior executives, global teams, and external partners around a common transformation agenda
• Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required; PMP (or equivalent certification) preferred.
• Fluency in English is required, German desirable
• Willingness to travel globally (30%+) is expected Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. As Scientist Automation Workflows, Development Bioconjugates, your primary focus will be to establish laboratory automation workflows, collaborating closely with project teams to drive the integration of automation into our daily operations. In addition, you will be responsible for the planning and execution of laboratory experiments for bioconjugates process development. We are looking for you if you are passionate about automation, a great team player and motivated to bring bioconjugate-based biopharmaceuticals to the patient. What you will get:
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• A highly collaborative environment that fosters teamwork and inclusion
• A range of professional development programs to grow your skills and career
• An ethical workplace where tasks are carried out in accordance to the relevant procedures
• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Develop and implement automation workflows across various scales in bioconjugate development
• Collaborate with project teams to translate project needs into automated solutions
• Train and support laboratory technicians in the execution of automated workflows and ensure scientifically sound execution of experiments
• Plan, perform and document laboratory experiments in collaboration with laboratory technicians
• Evaluate data for the preparation of reports or presentations
• Support project leaders in the planning and organization of projects and experiments What we are looking for:
• BSc. or MSc. degree in chemistry, biotechnology or a related field
• Completion of an apprenticeship as a laboratory technician is beneficial
• Hands-on experience with automated lab equipment, such as liquid handlers and small-scale/g-scale automated systems
• Good understanding of general laboratory routines
• Experience in bioconjugation, protein handling, protein chromatography is a plus
• Sense of accuracy, quality and proactive problem-solving
• Reliable team player with excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude; open-minded for new ideas and suggestions; agile, highly motivated and dynamic; solution-oriented
• Good written and oral communication skills in English and German About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for a Head of Quality for BioAtrium, based in Visp, Switzerland. BioAtrium’s Head of Quality is responsible for all quality-related aspects of the activities undertaken at the site, in accordance with all applicable laws and regulations including quality agreements entered into with Sanofi and Lonza. The incumbant will be the designated responsible person (Fachtechnische verantwortliche Person) for BioAtrium AG according to the Medicinal Products Licensing Ordinance, SR 812.212.1 (Arzneimittel Bewilligungsverordnung). Key Responsibilities: The Head of Quality has the authority to decide on all Quality-relevant decisions and holds the following permanent responsibilities and accountabilities: Most Responsible Quality Person on-site (FvP): Responsibilities include, but not limited to:
• Overall responsibility for disposition of batches.
• Ensure escalation of critical quality issuers.
• Oversee Quality Management review process including annual quality plan.
• Ensures Quality System meets regulatory expectations, including approval of SOPs for key quality systems.
• Approve annual product reviews.
• Manage recall process.
• Approves inspection and audit reports.
• Approves QA agreements with customers. Quality strategy and Leadership at BioAtrium AG: The Head of Quality defines quality vision and quality strategy.
• The quality vision and quality strategy will be based on the overall vison and strategy of BioAtrium.
• The quality vision will foster compliance, risk and science thinking to direct the quality organization towards a modern organization having eventually the patient’s wellbeing in top of their mind.
• On periodic basis, milestone plans with defined quality initiatives to ensure to follow the quality strategy will be defined and subsequently executed.
• Acts as a change agent, driving high Quality Standards and a culture of continuous improvement.
• Develops talents through coaching and fostering continuous learning. Quality Management System of BioAtrium: Head of Quality maintains a compliant quality management system at BioAtrium:
• Monitoring of key performance indicators to assess the efficiency of the quality system, of the quality culture, and of appropriate staffing.
• Assures qualified status of facility, equipment, processes and cleaning, test methods, IT infrastructure and application during the lifecycle of products, of related systems and of the facility.
• Follows up on current GMP trends and ensures that plans are in place to maintain BioAtrium in a state of compliance.
• Oversight of all outsourced services as well as management of any incoming complaints. Inspection and regulatory agencies: The Head of Quality maintains an active and successful collaboration with Swissmedic to ensure the Manufacturing License for BioAtrium according to the Medicinal Products Licensing Ordinance (SR 812.212.1) including successful inspections of the BioAtrium facility. This includes also the collaboration with all foreign health authorities as well as any customer inspections to ensure the site is inspection-ready at any time. Ensure a smooth inspection organization including the set-up of back and front office, timely and adequate response to inspection observations and focused follow-up on all CAPA plans. Key Requirements, Qualifications, Skills & Behavior:
• Master Degree in Life Sciences or related education.
• Several years’ of experience in leading GMP biopharmaceutical quality operations.
• Many years’ of experience leading multi-disciplinary teams in pharma, vaccines or biopharmaceuticals.
• Demonstrated leadership of site management teams.
• Start-up experience of manufacturing facilities or businesses.
• Expert in Quality understanding of Drug Substance (ICH Q7) and understanding current trends.
• Expert in GMP manufacturing of biopharmaceutical Drug Substances.
• Knowledge of development and technology transfer of therapeutic protein processes.
• Trained in Operational Excellence in a GMP environment.
• Quality and GMP compliance mindset.
• Customer facing skills.
• Representing the Joint venture to customers, regulatory inspectors and stakeholders.
• English and German language is essential.
• French language is an advantage. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. For our Visp Integrated Biologics and Specialized Modality organizations, we are seeking an Automation Lead to manage programs that strengthen operational capability and standardization, and contribute to recipe management efficiencies. Key Responsibilities:
• Lead and manage a team of Automation Engineers, ensuring team functionality and alignment with operational priorities.
• Deliver on direct line management responsibilities, including mentoring, performance feedback, and development planning.
• Collaborate with Operations, MSAT, and Quality across business platforms to align automation objectives with business strategy.
• Coordinate schedules and deliverables, to meet the needs of Integrated Biologics and Specialized Modality operations while managing team capacity effectively.
• Manage a local Center of Excellence for MES and DCS Automation, working with the global Center of Excellence to standardize automation approaches in biopharma manufacturing.
• Act as an integrator—removing barriers, ensuring consistent communication, and building alignment between global strategy and site operations.
• Contribute automation expertise to design development teams.
• Provide high-level troubleshooting support with the team.
• Act as a subject matter expert in DeltaV and Syncade systems, GMP lifecycle management, and biological manufacturing
• Manage compliance tasks related to multi-asset SOP assessments and CAPAs and ensure timely closure. Requirements:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Biochemistry, or related fields, or equivalent experience.
• Experience: 5+ years in Biologics GMP manufacturing with operational experience and strong knowledge of MES/DeltaV systems.
• Technical Skills: Advanced knowledge of DeltaV, MES and GMP manufacturing principles and compliance in automation.
• Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead teams, get results, and promote collaboration across departments.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Location: The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. The role: The Senior QA Specialist (f/m/d) for QA Projects specifies quality requirements for manufacturing processes and cGMP standards over their entire life cycle. As a Quality and Compliance representative he/she will be a key member in cross-functional project teams ensuring measures for product safety, product quality & cGMP compliance are implemented. What you will get:
• An agile career and dynamic working culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance
• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits. What you will do:
• Own all quality related responsibilities for the manufacturing processes of biopharmaceutical products for clinical and commercial supply. Represent QA in project/tech transfer organizations for new biotech manufacturing processes.
• Responsible for review and final release of records like Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Master Manufacturing Batch Records, Material Specifications, Deviations, Change Requests, Effectiveness Checks, Testing Protocols & Reports etc.
• Perform assessments for all product-related changes, assesses relevance to regulatory filings, decide to implement and provide change controls for approval to customers where required.
• Ensure all deviations are appropriately investigated and recorded, direct the investigations of customer product complaints and assure the completion of the appropriate documentation.
• Identifie emerging QA relevant topics, communicate to the IBEX QA organization and work actively on their development into new or already established Quality and Compliance strategies and/or standards.
• Train and mentor junior Lonza employees to better accomplish and perform in their duties as Quality professionals. Support cGMP training programs to ensure staff is being trained. What we are looking for:
• Academic degree in Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Life Science or any related field.
• Solid experience in the GMP regulated pharmaceutical industry; preferably in a QA role.
• General knowledge of biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes and analytical methods.
• Experienced in the interaction with health authorities (Swissmedic, FDA etc.).
• Ability to oversee project execution to identify non-compliance from quality standards. Ability to prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.
• Structured, focused and well-organized working attitude; open-minded for new ideas and suggestions; agile, highly motivated and dynamic drive.
• Strong team orientation with excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
• Business fluent English is required, good German skills - an advantage About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

An unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir für den Bereich der chemischen Pharmaproduktion Visp MES(Syncade)/DCS(DeltaV) Spezialisten. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben:
• Sie erstellen, testen und optimieren den automatisierten Produktionsablauf.
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem zuständigen Anlageteam (Chemiker, Anlage- und Automationsingenieur, QA Manager, Anlagemeister) während der Planungsphase und der Produktion.
• Erstellung und Anpassung von Rezepturen im DeltaV und MES.
• Teilnahme an Risiko- und Prozessabweichungsanalysen.
• In Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Abteilungen stellen Sie die cGMP-gerechte Dokumentation sicher.
• Sie verbessern ständig Abläufe und Prozesse unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits-, Hygiene-, Umwelt- und Qualitätsanforderungen.
• Sie erkennen Risiken in Bezug auf Sicherheit oder Compliance/GMP, thematisieren diese und arbeiten mit bei deren Behebung. Was wir suchen:
• Fundierte Erfahrung in der Verfahrenstechnik und Produktion und/oder im Erstellen von DeltaV und MES Rezepten (Syncade).
• Bereitschaft zur internen Weiterbildung zum MES/DeltaV Spezialisten.
• Die Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen und den Teammitgliedern gehört zu Ihren Stärken
• Sie sind ein Planungs- und Organisationstalent bei komplexen Projekten und haben eine stets lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
• Sie sprechen deutsch und haben Grundkenntnisse in Englisch. Wir bieten attraktive Benefits sowie ein umfassendes Relocation-Paket für talentierte neue Mitarbeitende. Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. title: Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Architettura, Infrastruttura e Operazioni IT
titleByLocale.en: Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations
titleByLocale.de: Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations
titleByLocale.fr: Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations

descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are seeking a Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations to lead the global technology agenda across development and manufacturing operations within a highly regulated life‑sciences / CDMO environment. The Head IT Architecture, Infrastructure and Operations is accountable for defining and executing enterprise technology strategy and architecture that enables digital manufacturing, data & AI, quality and compliance excellence, cybersecurity, and scalable growth. Operating in close partnership with the CIO and senior business leaders, this role ensures technology platforms deliver impact on yield, reliability, speed, compliance, and supply resilience across a multi‑site footprint. Key Responsibilities
• Enterprise Technology Strategy & Architecture: Define and execute a multi‑year enterprise technology strategy and roadmap covering cloud, data, AI/ML, OT/edge, and cybersecurity, aligned to corporate objectives and CIO enterprise standards.
• Digital Manufacturing & OT / IT Convergence: Lead Industry 4.0 initiatives across global sites, including advanced automation, real‑time release, predictive maintenance, robotics, and secure OT/IT integration.
• Data, Analytics & AI Enablement: Build and operate an enterprise data platform with strong metadata, lineage, and master data management foundations.
• Cybersecurity & Risk in Regulated Environments: Drive security‑by‑design across manufacturing, lab, product, and cloud platforms.
• GxP Compliance, Validation & Inspection Readiness: Institutionalize CSV/CSA approaches for GxP computerized systems across their full lifecycle.
• Innovation Portfolio & External Partnerships: Identify, evaluate, and incubate emerging technologies such as generative AI, digital twins, advanced sensors, and continuous manufacturing.
• Talent, Operating Model & Vendor Ecosystem: Build and lead high‑performing global engineering, data, and product organizations.
• Budgeting & Investment Governance: Co‑own technology investment planning (CapEx/OpEx), lifecycle management, and value realization. Required Experience & Qualifications
• 15+ years of global technology leadership experience, including responsibility for large‑scale platforms, engineering, and enterprise transformations across multiple sites.
• Proven delivery of digital manufacturing in GxP‑regulated environments with FDA/EMA exposure.
• Strong experience with OT/IT convergence and cybersecurity in regulated manufacturing environments.
• Experience within or with CDMOs, biopharma manufacturers, or similarly regulated life‑sciences organizations.
• Track record of innovation portfolio leadership with measurable business value.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. The actual location of this job is in Basel, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world — the satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. Lonza is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Nexus Internship Location: Visp, Switzerland Full Time, On Site. The role focuses on identifying business-relevant SAP AI use cases, assessing infrastructure readiness, and contributing to the design and development of a custom AI agent (“Customer Project Builder”) that automates the conversion of customer contract data into structured SAP project data. What you will get:
• 3 month internship working for a global organization
• Hands-on experience with a wide range of tools and implementing artificial intelligence capabilities
• A supportive team environment with training, coaching and clear development pathways. What you will do:
• Analyze and evaluate SAP AI technologies, including SAP Joule Co-Pilot and SAP Business AI capabilities
• Assess current SAP BTP landscape and identify infrastructure gaps for AI enablement
• Collaborate with Nexus IT and business stakeholders to identify and prioritize AI use cases
• Support development of SAP AI strategy recommendations and implementation roadmap
• Support the design and develop a custom AI agent (“Customer Project Builder”) for document-to-data automation What we are looking for
• Availability for full-time internship during the defined period
• Interest in working in a global, highly regulated industry (pharma/CDMO)
• Willingness to work in Visp and collaborate across locations
• Strong motivation to bridge business and technology About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. descriptionByLocale.it:
An unserem Standort in Visp, Switzerland suchen wir einen Praktikant (m/w/d) in QC Mikrobiologie. Die QC Mikrobiologie beschäftigt sich mit grossen Bereich von Mikrobiologie-Analysen und ist verantwortlich für die gesamte Mikrobiologie seitens Lonza, in Visp. Wir suchen einen Praktikanten (m/w/d) um unseres Team zu erweitern. Was auf Sie wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Ihre Aufgaben: Durchführung einer Reihe von Analysen und Studien in der QC Mikrobiologie:
• Bioburden Analysen
• Endotoxin Analysen
• Keim Identifizierung
• Medienherstellung
• Sorgen für Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Labor
• Logistikarbeiten Was wir suchen:
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Biologielaborant (m/w/d), BSc Biologie, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Erfahrung im GMP-Umfeld ist von Vorteil
• Erfahrung mit mikrobiologischen Untersuchungen ist von Vorteil
• Erste Erfahrungen mit LIMS, iLAB oder MODA sind vom Vorteil
• Sichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab Über Lonza Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen. Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen. Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

Dazu soll eine Analyse des Anlagestatus gegenüber dem State-of-the-Art durchgeführt werden, ein Kriterienkatalog erstellt und anhand dessen Projekte beurteilt werden. Was auf dich wartet:
• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur.
• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld.
• Eine Vielzahl von Vorteilen, abhängig von Funktion und Standort. Deine Aufgaben:
• Definition und begründetet Dokumentation eines technischen Standards und Ausrüstung von Apparaten wie beispielsweise Reaktoren, Nutschen, Zentrifugen, Trocknern in Bezug auf Produktion, Reinigung, Produkteumstellung, Instandhaltung.
• Gap-Analyse des vorhandenen Equipments gegenüber des technischen Standards im Bezug auf Sicherheit und GMP-Compliance und Effizienz
• Mitarbeit an Risikoanalysen und Umsetzung von daraus resultierenden Massnahmen
• Entwicklung und Evaluation möglicher Projekte zum Schliessen vorhandener Gaps

• Selbständiges und strukturiertes Arbeiten, ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit
• Interesse an Produktionsabläufen und Verständnis von R&I Fliessbildern

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families. The Waste Logistics Expert plays a central role in our waste logistics operations, acting as a high-level specialist and the primary deputy for the Waste Logistics Manager. In this capacity, you will ensure that all waste disposal processes are safe, compliant, and efficient while actively contributing to the optimization of our logistics and sustainability goals. The role of this person is to serve as a vital support function within waste management, maintaining high-quality services that meet the expectations of various stakeholders, regulatory requirements, and operational targets. You will be responsible for a broad scope of different facilities. The hired candidate will act as a key interface between operational logistics, production plants, laboratories, strategic growth projects, safety departments, and the supply chain. You will assist in ensuring that our facilities meet long-term sustainability objectives and strictly adhere to GMP and safety standards. They will also act as a proactive problem solver, identifying operational challenges early and initiating measures to ensure Business Continuity through alternative disposal routes and data-driven process improvements. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ This role is primarily based on site. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely for no more than 20% of your time. Requests are considered on a case‑by‑case basis, in line with business needs. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.
• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Take operative and strategic responsibility for waste-related activities across different facilities
• Ensure strict adherence to all relevant GMP, safety, and environmental regulations, including performing detailed risk assessments.
• Act as the central point of contact for internal teams (Production, EHS, Engineering) and external waste disposal partners.
• Monitor the "disposability" of materials and secure alternative disposal paths to prevent operational bottlenecks.
• Standardize cross-functional waste processes and leverage technology or data-driven approaches to improve efficiency.
• Control KPIs, generate detailed reports, and derive actionable improvement measures to promote recycling and sustainable solutions.
• Support and represent the Waste Logistics Manager in strategic projects and daily management tasks. What we are looking for:
• Degree in Chemical/Pharma Technology, Environmental Engineering, Biotechnology, Waste Management, or a comparable qualification (alternatively, extensive practical experience in a similar environment).
• Minimum 10 years of experience in chemical or biopharmaceutical production or long-term operational experience in high-complexity logistics.
• Deep knowledge of safety standards (SECO, SUVA, EKAS), GMP guidelines, and the handling of hazardous materials.
• Experience with ERP and logistics systems such as SAP, TrackWise, Syncrotess, or similar tools.
• Advanced IT and data analysis capabilities, particularly with MS Office, PowerBI, and modern reporting tools.
• Strong analytical thinking, resilience, and the ability to lead and develop teams when acting in a deputy capacity.
• Very good command of both German and English is required for cross-functional collaboration. About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board. Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now. Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do:
• Ensure the successful and timely delivery of QC work packages for assigned projects.
• Review and approve assay documentation under cGMP following applicable SOPs and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) in a right first time and timely manner.
• maintain up-to-date knowledge of analytical method capabilities for assigned projects
• Take ownership for actions required by quality events under cGMP (e.g SST failures / OOx / investigations / Deviations, CAPAs)

descriptionByLocale.it:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland. For our successful Drug Product Services (DPS) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Associate Principal Scientist Process Development DP position. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture
• An inclusive and ethical workplace
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance What you will do:
• Assist establishment of Drug Product process development infrastructure and services for parenteral drug products for clinical and commercial use
• Install, qualify, and maintain equipment for process development, non-GMP manufacturing and related analytics in close alignment with current best practices and regulations
• Plan and perform process development and characterization studies for liquid and lyophilized parenteral drug products of biologics (e.g. monoclonal antibodies, novel formats, ADCs, peptides) and small molecules
• Document data following applicable lab procedures and current documentation practices
• Act as project lead for assigned projects, being the customer’s SPOC for DPS activities
• Enable innovation and technical strategy projects, generate IP and contribute to scientific publications
• Execute analytical tests to support formulation and process development (e.g. HPLC and CE purity methods, content by UV, identity, color, clarity and opalescence, pH, osmolality, visible particles, subvisible particles)
• Manufacture non-GMP drug product samples for supportive stability studies and preclinical use (e.g. GLP tox studies) applying aseptic working techniques
• Support manufacture of clinical drug supplies at GMP sites What we are looking for:
• Science or engineering degree (PhD, MSc) in a relevant discipline, e.g. Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical or Biochemical Engineering, or a training on the job as lab technician, or equivalent
• Work experience as a research/technical assistant in the pharmaceutical or chemical industry, preferably in process development
• Understanding of Drug Product process development, and technical knowledge of handling basic analytical equipment e.g. UV-VIS, pH, osmolality
• Experience with parenteral dosage forms, protein formulation and analytics and aseptic working techniques is a plus
• Very good knowledge of reporting, interpretation and documentation of scientific results
• Strong communication skills and ability to work independently within a team
• Excellent knowledge of written and spoken English About Lonza At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. descriptionByLocale.it:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for a Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence. Role Purpose: The Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence is critical for driving and overseeing the successful execution of strategic Quality Compliance programs/projects in alignment with the LGQ, IT, Operations, and the Quality Enabling Functions. This role is responsible for Lonza Quality Plan preparation and governance, managing the overall Compliance & Risk Management planning and reporting processes, facilitating Compliance, cross functional, and Global Quality Councils and serves as the touchpoint for to the leadership communications. The role serves as an ambassador and change agent for Compliance and Quality Excellence strategy and execution, in alignment with Lonza strategic imperatives, across platforms, functions, and regions. Key Responsibilities: Risk Management Framework Governance:
• Lead the governance framework providing guidance and support to managers across platforms and functions.
• Develops content for and facilitates strategic monthly leadership team meetings, as may be required.

Sofern erforderlich, steht berechtigten Kandidaten und ihren Familien Unterstützung beim Umzug zur Verfügung.

Werde Teil unseres Engineering‑Teams als Anlagetechniker Vibe-X 80-100% (m/w/d) in Visp. Bringe deine technische Expertise in ein Umfeld ein, das Qualität, Sicherheit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung lebt. Du betreust Umbau‑ und Neubauprojekte, optimierst Anlagen und stellst sicher, dass alle Instandhaltungsarbeiten reibungslos und termingerecht ablaufen.

Was wir Dir bieten:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integrativer und ethischer Arbeitsplatz

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Vorbereitung, Koordination und Durchführung von Instandhaltungsarbeiten an den pharmazeutischen Herstellanlagen unter Berücksichtigung von GMP-Aspekten unter Einbeziehung interner und externer Partner

• Überwachung von Instandhaltungsaufträgen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Tasks pünktlich ausgeführt werden

• Erstellen und Bearbeiten von Wartungsplänen und Checklisten in SAP PM

• Technische Betreuung von Umbau-, Ausbau- und Neubauprojekten im Bereich der pharmazeutischen Herstellanlagen

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Maschinen und Anlagen, von Instandhaltungsprozessen sowie von internen Abläufen

• Einhaltung gültiger Standards hinsichtlich Sicherheit, Hygiene, Umwelt, Qualität

• Mitarbeit bei der Überwachung und Einhaltung des zur Verfügung stehenden Budgets (Unterhalt, Umstellungen und Investitionen)

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufslehre (idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker)

• Berufserfahrung in Betrieb, Instandhaltung und Neubau von Maschinen und Anlagen bevorzugt in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld der Pharma- oder Biotechindustrie

• Gute Kenntnisse in GMP, COMOS, SAP - von Vorteil

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten; starker Teamplayer; sehr guter Kommunikationsstil

• Handwerkliches Geschick sowie belastbare, lösungsorientierte und positive Persönlichkeit

• Englisch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift); Deutsch (gute Kenntnisse)

Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten? Jetzt bewerben

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

• Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Sie zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen finden Sie auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Deine Aufgaben:

• Vorbereitung, Koordination und Durchführung von Instandhaltungsarbeiten an den pharmazeutischen Herstellanlagen unter Berücksichtigung von GMP-Aspekten unter Einbeziehung interner und externer Partner

• Überwachung von Instandhaltungsaufträgen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Tasks pünktlich ausgeführt werden

• Erstellen und Bearbeiten von Wartungsplänen und Checklisten in SAP PM

• Technische Betreuung von Umbau-, Ausbau- und Neubauprojekten im Bereich der pharmazeutischen Herstellanlagen

• Kontinuierliche Optimierung der Maschinen und Anlagen, von Instandhaltungsprozessen sowie von internen Abläufen

• Einhaltung gültiger Standards hinsichtlich Sicherheit, Hygiene, Umwelt, Qualität

• Mitarbeit bei der Überwachung und Einhaltung des zur Verfügung stehenden Budgets (Unterhalt, Umstellungen und Investitionen)

Dein Anforderungsprofil:

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufslehre (idealerweise mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker)

• Berufserfahrung in Betrieb, Instandhaltung und Neubau von Maschinen und Anlagen bevorzugt in einem GMP-regulierten Umfeld der Pharma- oder Biotechindustrie

• Gute Kenntnisse in GMP, COMOS, SAP - von Vorteil

• Selbständiges und flexibles Arbeiten; starker Teamplayer; sehr guter Kommunikationsstil

• Handwerkliches Geschick sowie belastbare, lösungsorientierte und positive Persönlichkeit

• Englisch (fliessend in Wort und Schrift); Deutsch (gute Kenntnisse)

Über Lonza:

Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere größte Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob groß oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.

Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüßen zu dürfen.
