The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. The Senior Strategic Buyer Indirect IT/OT will be part of the Indirect Procurement team and reports to the Head of Indirect Procurement Categories: Technology, Professional Services & MRO. The successful candidate will collaborate effectively with the Global IT/OT Category manager and other Category Managers to deliver value and continuous improvement to assigned sites and their stakeholders. The role of this person is to partner with key stakeholders to ensure business continuity and verify that procurement activities meet specific site business needs. You will provide essential purchasing expertise in tendering, negotiation, and contracting while managing the delegated spend. The hired candidate will be responsible for driving savings initiatives by developing a pipeline of projects and realizing cost reductions with delegated suppliers. You will manage supplier relationships in liaison with delegated spend, overseeing an annual portfolio of up to 50 million. You will also act as a support for the roll-out of new procurement policies, procedures, and tools, ensuring the optimization of transactional costs and efficiency across the organization. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBoAVhfTkTQ This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. What you will get:
• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.
• An inclusive and ethical workplace.
• Compensation programs that recognize high performance. In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below. Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi What you will do:
• Support Category Managers with category and sourcing strategy development by providing site-specific business needs and reporting local market trends.
• Execute sourcing initiatives for delegated spend across assigned sites, providing expertise in negotiation tactics and planning.
• Manage the supplier portfolio to leverage capabilities, improve supply continuity, and reduce the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
• Track country savings performance and identify potential risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Identify and partner with site stakeholders (Budget owners, Legal, etc.) to understand and support current and future business needs.
• Drive the utilization of leading-edge sourcing tools, including on-line catalogues and E-Auctions.
• Perform comprehensive supply risk assessments across the existing supplier portfolio, including financial and quality risks.
• Ensure the ERP system and RM documentation databases are accurately maintained. What we are looking for:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Procurement, or Supply Chain.
• 5–10 years of experience in Strategic Procurement; experience within the Pharma or a high-quality industry is preferred.
• Business fluent in English.
• Expertise in procurement processes: category management, supplier management, and contract management.
• Hands-on experience using SAP, Ariba, and Microsoft Office.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously.
• Ability to persuade and influence suppliers to achieve the best outcomes for the business.
• Knowledge of process improvement and a customer service-oriented mindset.

descriptionByLocale.en:
## Descrizione
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, ensuring a smooth transition to our welcoming community in Visp.

Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of.

We are looking for a DeltaV Automation Engineer or Electrical Instrumentation & Control Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in a dynamic, cutting-edge environment where your work will significantly contribute to shaping the future of medicine.

## Cosa offriamo
• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• A variety of benefits dependant on role and location

• The full list of our global benefits can be also found on https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits.

## Mansioni
• Planning and realization of electrical MSR readiness (maintenance, changeovers, improvements) within the available budget and timelines

• Ensuring seamless operation and flawless performance of high-automated Biologics facilities equipped with DeltaV and MES systems. Equivalent experience is also acceptable for educational requirements like MES

• Managing GMP-compliant activities, including testing, documentation, and change management using systems such as Kneat and Ubik

• Preparing and updating plant documentation in SAP/COMOS to ensure strict compliance with regulatory standards

• Determining and implementing continuous improvements in equipment and maintenance processes to improve efficiency and reliability

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine internal procedures and achieve optimized workflows

## Requisiti
• Equivalent experience in Electrical or System Engineering or a related field, including University Degree or equivalent experience, or vocational education (EFZ, FH, HF, BSc.)

• Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of pharmaceutical plants or the biotech industry

• Proficiency in SAP, COMOS (Plant Engineering Software), DeltaV (Process Control System), and MES Syncade (Manufacturing Execution System) is highly desirable

• Proficient in English and/or German to competently communicate in our diverse, collaborative environment

• Familiarity with GMP standards and protocols to ensure compliance in a regulated manufacturing setting

• A self-reliant, trustworthy, and effective working approach that ensures successful completion of tasks and projects

## Contatto
Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. descriptionByLocale.de: Umzugsunterstützung steht berechtigen Kandidaten und ihren Familien bei Bedarf zur Verfügung. Lonza ist heute ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Life Sciences, welches auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Wir sind in der Wissenschaft tätig, jedoch gibt es keine Zauberformel dafür, wie wir die Arbeit angehen. Unsere wichtigste wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Mitarbeitende, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die anderen Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug steuern unsere Mitarbeitenden ihre Karriere selbstständig. Denn ihre Ideen, ob gross und klein, verbessern die Welt. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir Teil haben möchten. Für unseren Standort in Visp suchen wir einen Anlagen- und Apparatebauer Rohrbau EFZ. Was wir dir bieten: • Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur • Einen integrativen und ethischen Arbeitsplatz • Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen • Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten dich zahlreiche Vorteile in den Bereichen Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Die vollständige Liste unserer globalen Leistungen findest du auch unter: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi Deine Aufgaben: • Fachgerechtes und wirtschaftliches Ausmessen, Herstellen und Montieren von anspruchsvollen Rohrleitungen und Stützsystemen im Rohrleitungsbau • Erstellen von Isometrien und Rohrleitungssegmenten entsprechend den technischen Vorgaben und Projektanforderungen • Planen und Organisieren der Arbeitsabläufe anhand von R&I‑Fliessbildern, bei Projektarbeiten und Anlagenanpassungen • Anwenden von PED‑Richtlinien sowie Arbeiten nach internen Rohrklassen, Werknormen und qualitätssichernden Vorgaben Dein Profil: • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Anlagen- und Apparatebauer EFZ in Rohrleitungsbau, Rohrschlosser, Heizungsmonteur oder Sanitär-Installateur • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Rohrschlosser oder Vorrichter von Vorteil • Bereitschaft zu kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung • Freude an abteilungsübergreifender Arbeit sowie selbstständiges und flexibles Arbeiten im Team • Zuverlässigkeit, Belastbarkeit sowie unternehmerisches Handeln und offene, direkte Kommunikation • Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Lonzas Produkte und Services wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns stellt dies nicht nur eine grosse Ehre, sondern auch eine grosse Verantwortung, dar. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erreichen ist für uns genauso wichtig wie unsere Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza wird Respekt grossgeschrieben und wir schützen sowohl unsere Mitarbeiter als auch unsere Umwelt. Erfolg für uns bedeutet moralisch vertretbarer Fortschritt. Zu Lonza kommen Menschen, die Herausforderungen annehmen und mit ihrer Kreativität im Bereich Life Science neue Ideen für komplexe Problemstellungen entwickeln. Zusammen leisten wir einen Beitrag, der das Leben vieler Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verbessern kann. Dies bietet ihnen die Gewissheit und die Zufriedenheit, mit der eigenen Arbeit wirklich einen Unterschied zu machen. Bereit, die Zukunft der Life Sciences mitzugestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in cinque continenti. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo essere parte. Stiamo cercando un Capo Globale di Compliance e Risk Management Governance e Intelligence. ## Mansioni ### Scopo del ruolo Il Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence Ã ̈ fondamentale per guidare e supervisionare la riuscita dell'esecuzione dei programmi/progetti strategici di Compliance in allineamento con LGQ, IT, Operations e le funzionalitÃ di QualitÃ che consentono. Questo ruolo è responsabile per la preparazione e la governance del Piano di Qualità di Lonza, la gestione dei processi di pianificazione e reporting Compliance & Risk Management, facilitando Compliance, Cross Functions e Global Quality Councils e funge da punto di contatto per le comunicazioni di leadership. Il ruolo serve come ambasciatore e agente di cambiamento per la strategia e l'esecuzione di Compliance and Quality Excellence, in linea con gli imperativi strategici Lonza, attraverso piattaforme, funzioni e regioni. #### Key Responsibilities - Siti di supporto e piattaforme aziendali durante le ispezioni regolamentari, indagini complesse e argomenti di conformità escalati, come necessario. - Funziona a stretto contatto con Compliance Head per gestire complesse escalation e affrontare le esigenze di leadership esecutiva. - Global Execution of Quality Compliance & QMS Strategy: - Assicurare l'esecuzione operativa di tutte le iniziative strategiche all'interno di Compliance & QMS, guidando la standardizzazione e il miglioramento delle prestazioni. - Guidare e condurre l'attuazione della gestione dei cambiamenti all'interno della pianificazione operativa per incorporare nuovi processi, sistemi e modi di lavoro. - supervisionare lo sviluppo, il monitoraggio e la segnalazione del Piano Qualità di Lonza, assicurando visibilità e responsabilità attraverso le funzioni. - Monitorare e guidare il benchmarking dei miglioramenti globali e la mitigazione del rischio proattivo. - Analisi dei dati e Reporting: - Preparare e presentare report dettagliati sulle prestazioni strategiche del programma/progetto, sullo stato del rischio e sulle metriche operative. - Stakeholder Engagement: - Costruisci forti relazioni con i team di leadership Global Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Finance e Platform/site. - Utilizzare la leadership indiretta per guidare il processo decisionale e l'allineamento in un ambiente globale a matrice. - Facilitare le discussioni a livello esecutivo, assicurando l'equilibrio tra priorità strategiche e realtà operative. - Influenzi costantemente gli stakeholder per mantenere l'attenzione sugli obiettivi di qualità a lungo termine. ## Requisiti ## Skills - Forte leadership e competenze di gestione del team. - Eccellente capacità di gestione del progetto. - Eccellente esperienza di qualità e conformità. - Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving. - Alta attenzione ai dettagli e alle capacità organizzative. - Comunicazione superiore e competenze interpersonali. - Proficienza in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) e strumenti di analisi dei dati. #### Requisiti chiave: Qualifiche & Esperienza - Esperienza di progetti di leadership e crescita multisito - Registrazione di successo con le ispezioni delle autorità sanitarie (FDA, EMA, ecc.). - Esperienza nella gestione di team multifunzionali complessi in un ambiente aziendale multinazionale. - Esperienza nel lavoro in un ambiente multiculturale e multinazionale. - In grado di lavorare in una struttura a matrice. - Forte e comprovata capacità di leadership. # Cosa# offriamo Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. descriptionByLocale.en: Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across five continents. While we work in science, there’s no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that’s the kind of work we want to be part of. We are looking for a Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence. Role Purpose: The Global Head of Compliance and Risk Management Governance and Intelligence is critical for driving and overseeing the successful execution of strategic Quality Compliance programs/projects in alignment with the LGQ, IT, Operations, and the Quality Enabling Functions. This role is responsible for Lonza Quality Plan preparation and governance, managing the overall Compliance & Risk Management planning and reporting processes, facilitating Compliance, cross functional, and Global Quality Councils and serves as the touchpoint for to the leadership communications. The role serves as an ambassador and change agent for Compliance and Quality Excellence strategy and execution, in alignment with Lonza strategic imperatives, across platforms, functions, and regions. Key Responsibilities: Risk Management Framework Governance: • Lead the governance framework providing guidance and support to managers across platforms and functions. • Develops content for and facilitates strategic monthly leadership team meetings, as may be required. • Supports development and monitoring of global Quality Councils, including action tracking/minutes and Quality Plans. • Oversees Compliance programs/projects from initiation through to completion. • Monitors program/project progress and performance, ensuring timely delivery and quality outcomes. • Establishes/maintains project management standards and methodologies within in alignment with the One Lonza Vision Operates as SME/SPOC for competency areas, supporting troubleshooting, audits & inspections, etc. as required. • Support sites and business platforms during regulatory inspections, complex investigations, and escalated compliance topics, as needed. • Works closely with Compliance Head to complex manage escalations and address Executive leadership needs. Global Execution of Quality Compliance & QMS Strategy: • Ensure operational execution of all strategic initiatives within Compliance & QMS, driving standardization and performance improvement. • Drive and lead the implementation of change management within operational planning to embed new processes, systems, and ways of working. • Oversee the development, monitoring, and reporting of the Lonza Quality Plan, ensuring visibility and accountability across functions. • Monitor and drive global improvements benchmarking, and proactive risk mitigation. Data Analysis and Reporting: • Prepare and present detailed reports on strategic Quality program/project performance, risk status and operational metrics. • Manage the business reporting process (e.g., weekly huddle reports, monthly Quality reports, quarterly batch release review, etc.) • Responsible for development of Quality KPI and KQI targets and monitors performance monthly (or as may be required based on projects, priorities). Stakeholder Engagement: • Build strong relationships with Global Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Operations, Finance, and platform/site leadership teams. • Use indirect leadership to drive decision-making and alignment in a matrixed global environment. • Facilitate executive-level discussions, ensuring balance between strategic priorities and operational realities. • Continuously influence stakeholders to maintain focus on long-term Quality Excellence goals. Skills: • Strong leadership and team management skills. • Excellent project management skills. • Excellent Quality and Compliance experience. • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. • High attention to detail and organizational skills. • Superior communication and interpersonal skills. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and data analysis tools. Key Requirements: Qualifications & Experience • BSc or Masters degree in life science. • PMP Certification ICH Q8,9,10 Proficiency preferred. • Demonstrated success in managing large-scale, complex programs. • Experience in developing and implementing risk management frameworks. • Multisite leadership and Growth Projects experience • Successful track record with Health Authorities inspections (FDA, EMA, etc.). • Experience in managing complex multi-functional teams in a multinational business environment. • Experience in working in a multi-cultural and multi-national environment. • Able to work in a matrix-team structure. • Strong and proven leadership capabilities. Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically. People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference. descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie opérant sur cinq continents. Pendant que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour comment nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie. Nous cherchons un responsable mondial de la conformité et de la gestion des risques Gouvernance et renseignement. ## Mansioni ### Rôle But Le responsable mondial de la conformité et de la gestion des risques La gouvernance et l'intelligence sont essentielles pour diriger et superviser l'exécution réussie des programmes/projets stratégiques de conformité à la qualité, conformément aux LGQ, aux TI, aux opérations et aux fonctions habilitantes de qualité. Ce rôle est responsable de la préparation et de la gouvernance du Plan qualité de Lonza, de la gestion des processus globaux de planification et de rapport en matière de conformité et de gestion des risques, de la facilitation de la conformité, des conseils de qualité interfonctionnels et mondiaux et sert de point de contact pour les communications de leadership. Ce rôle sert d'ambassadeur et d'agent de changement pour la stratégie et l'exécution d'excellence en matière de conformité et de qualité, conformément aux impératifs stratégiques de Lonza, dans toutes les plateformes, fonctions et régions. ### Principales responsabilités - Appuie le développement et le suivi des conseils mondiaux de la qualité, y compris le suivi des actions/minutes et les plans de qualité. - Supervise les programmes et les projets de conformité depuis leur lancement jusqu'à leur achèvement. - Surveille l'avancement et le rendement des programmes et des projets, en veillant à ce que les résultats soient fournis en temps opportun et de qualité. - Établir/maintenir des normes et des méthodologies de gestion de projet en conformité avec la vision One Lonza fonctionne en tant que PME/SPOC pour les domaines de compétence, appuyer le dépannage, les audits et les inspections, etc., au besoin. - Soutenir les sites et les plates-formes d'affaires pendant les inspections réglementaires, les enquêtes complexes et les questions de conformité accrues, au besoin. - Collabore étroitement avec le chef de la conformité pour gérer les escalades complexes et répondre aux besoins de leadership de la haute direction. - Mise en oeuvre globale de la conformité à la qualité et de la stratégie du SGQ : - Assurer l'exécution opérationnelle de toutes les initiatives stratégiques au sein de la conformité et du SGQ, favorisant la normalisation et l'amélioration des performances. - Diriger et diriger la mise en oeuvre de la gestion du changement dans la planification opérationnelle afin d'intégrer de nouveaux processus, systèmes et méthodes de travail. - Superviser l'élaboration, le suivi et l'établissement de rapports sur le Plan qualité de Lonza, en assurant la visibilité et la responsabilisation de toutes les fonctions. - Surveiller et orienter l'analyse comparative des améliorations à l'échelle mondiale et l'atténuation proactive des risques. - Analyse des données et rapports : - Préparer et présenter des rapports détaillés sur le rendement stratégique du programme/projet Qualité, l'état des risques et les paramètres opérationnels. - Des programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent les hautes performances - Des salaires compétitifs - Une large gamme de avantages pour le style de vie, la famille et le loisir disponibles - La liste complète de nos avantages locaux peut également être trouvée sur assetstream.aspx ## Responsabilités - Agissez en tant qu'Expert MSAT dans les projets d'investissement en capital pour la construction et la mise en service d'unités de production, en assurant la préparation commerciale de l'installation de production GMP. - Définissez des stratégies et des concepts de qualification pour l'équipement de production DP et les salles propres dans le cadre des lignes de remplissage et finition asseptiques, conformément aux exigences réglementaires (par exemple, EU GMP, FDA, ICH). - Dirigez et agissez en tant que membre MSAT dans des équipes de projet pluridisciplinaires (par exemple, QA, Ingénierie, Production, QC). - Fournissez une leadership technique lors de la conception des processus de production stériles, y compris la disposition des salles propres, le flux de matériel/personnel et le placement des équipements. - Élaborer le concept de Simulation du Processus Asseptique en accord avec les lignes directrices internes et les exigences réglementaires. - Fournir une supervision et un soutien technique lors de l'exécution de l'APS et de toutes les enquêtes concernant le processus de production asseptique. - Soutenir le développement de programmes de formation en techniques asseptiques. - Diriger les évaluations des risques (par exemple, FMEA) pour identifier les paramètres critiques du processus de production et les stratégies de contrôle pour l'installation. - Rédiger et réviser les documents GMP tels que les plans maîtres de Qualification/Validation, les protocoles et rapports, les SOPs, les concepts de production, etc. - Assurez-vous que la documentation GMP est prête pour les inspections des autorités conformément aux normes de qualité internes et externes. - Contribuer au développement et à la mise en œuvre de procédures et processus MSAT standardisés, y compris les normes de qualification, les systèmes à usage unique et les systèmes de filtration. ## Exigences - Diplôme universitaire ou formation technique équivalente en Biotechnologie, Pharmacie ou domaine connexe - Une expérience significative dans les processus de remplissage et finition asseptiques/stériles de produits pharmaceutiques dans un environnement GMP est obligatoire, avec une connaissance approfondie des principes de traitement asseptique et d'assurance de stérilité. - Une expérience dans au moins l'un des domaines suivants est obligatoire : qualification de l'équipement de production ; validation de nettoyage ; qualification des salles - Excellentes compétences de communication, capable de traduire des sujets techniques complexes en messages clairs et actionnables. - Approche proactive, positive, mentalité de résolution de problèmes et capacité à prendre pleine responsabilité des zones attribuées. - Capacité à diriger des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à piloter la prise de décision dans une organisation matricielle ; construire des réseaux forts et la confiance entre les parties prenantes internes et externes. - Maîtrise de l'anglais est obligatoire ; les compétences en allemand sont un plus. ## Qui sommes-nous - Chez Lonza, nos personnes sont notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes mondialement connectées travaillent ensemble chaque jour pour produire les médicaments de demain. - Nos valeurs fondamentales de Collaboration, Responsabilité, Excellence, Passion et Intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. - Les idées de chacun, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons que vous fassiez partie. - L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de tous horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques à la table.
